fullPassage:
Various Volunteer Activities You Might Want to Participate in

Reading Volunteer Work
It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.

Longevity Photography Volunteer Work
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that ①<u>involves</u> reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can ②<u>participate</u> in the production of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the advantage of relatively ③<u>flexibly</u> scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and ④<u>demonstrating</u> proficiency.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ flexibly(부사) → flexible(형용사). scheduling(명사)을 수식하므로 형용사가 필요.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ③: 명사 scheduling을 수식하려면 형용사 flexible이 필요. flexibly는 부사.
❌ ① involves: 주어 It(단수) + involves 적합
❌ ② participate: can + 동사원형 적합
❌ ④ demonstrating: including + 동명사 병렬 적합
det.tip: 형용사 vs 부사: 명사 수식 → 형용사. flexible scheduling(유연한 일정)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① planting → planted. 나무가 '심어진' 후이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ①: once planted = once they are planted. 나무는 심기는 것(수동).
❌ ② in which: 전치사+관계대명사 적합
❌ ③ dedicated: 과거분사가 foundation을 수식 적합
❌ ④ organizes: The Seoul Green Trust(단수) + organizes 적합
det.tip: once + 과거분사: 수동 의미. once planted = 일단 심어지면 (= once they are planted)

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service ①<u>aimed</u> at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ provided → providing. such as + 동명사. 전치사(such as) 뒤에는 명사/동명사.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ④: such as providing(~을 제공하는 것과 같은). provided(과거분사)는 부적합.
❌ ① aimed: 과거분사가 service를 수식 적합
❌ ② live: help + 동사원형 적합
❌ ③ match: donations that match (관계대명사절 동사) 적합
det.tip: such as + 동명사(~ing): such as providing = 제공하는 것과 같은

questions.passage: It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the ①<u>production</u> of audiobooks for them. This activity offers the ②<u>disadvantage</u> of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain ③<u>standards</u>, including completing their education and demonstrating ④<u>proficiency</u> in standard language use and pronunciation.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② disadvantage(단점) → 원문: advantage(장점). 유연한 일정은 장점.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ②: disadvantage(단점)는 advantage(장점)의 반의어. 유연한 일정 관리가 '단점'이 될 수 없음.
❌ ① production(제작) 원문 적합
❌ ③ standards(기준) 원문 적합
❌ ④ proficiency(숙달) 원문 적합
det.tip: advantage(장점) ↔ disadvantage(단점). offers the advantage of = ~의 장점을 제공한다

questions.passage: Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ①<u>intensify</u> their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also ②<u>contribute</u> through talent ③<u>donations</u> that match your ④<u>skills</u>, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① intensify(심화시키다) → 원문: ease(완화하다). 재정적 부담을 '완화'하는 것이지 '심화'가 아님.
det.analysis:
✅ 정답 ①: intensify(심화)는 ease(완화)의 반의어. 봉사활동의 목적에 반함.
❌ ② contribute(기여하다) 원문 적합
❌ ③ donations(기부) 원문 적합
❌ ④ skills(기술) 원문 적합
det.tip: ease(완화하다) ↔ intensify(심화시키다). ease one's burdens = 부담을 줄이다

det.korean: ② 매달 → 원문: annual(연례/매년). 매달이 아니라 연례 행사.

It is a volunteer activity that involves reading aloud to the visually impaired or young children. Additionally, you can participate in the production of audiobooks for <u>them</u>. This activity offers the advantage of relatively flexible scheduling. However, participants must meet certain standards, including completing their education and demonstrating proficiency in standard language use and pronunciation.

Tree Caring Volunteer Work
Adopt-a-tree is a volunteer activity that helps keep trees beautiful and clean. Planting trees is important, but it is also important to take good care of the trees once planted. It is a volunteer activity in which local organizations and residents adopt "my tree" and take care of it and keep it clean. The Seoul Green Trust, a non-profit foundation dedicated to expanding and preserving green spaces, organizes an annual event on Arbor Day. During this event, citizens come together to plant and care for trees along the Hangang River.

Longevity Photography Volunteer Work
Longevity photography is a service aimed at creating healthy and happy memories through pictures for the elderly. It is driven not only by a desire to help the elderly live longer but also to ease their financial burdens. In addition to photography services, you can also contribute through talent donations that match your skills, such as providing makeup or hairstyling for the photo shoots.

det.analysis:

❌ ② 참가자들은 for them의 대상이 아님
❌ ③ 제작자는 주체이지 대상 아님
❌ ④ 교육 기관은 언급 없음
det.tip: 대명사 them → 앞 문장의 the visually impaired or young children을 받음.
